reviews.title: Okay app but total SCAM
reviews.text:
PLEASE BE CAREFUL

If I could leave a worse review, I would. This app literally STOLE my money, 69.99 for a year subscription that I did not want, after I had cancelled during the 7 day free trial. Total scam, BEWARE. I didn’t not want this at all, I was just trying it out. This is not the first time this has happened based on other reviews as well. 
Review that policies and agreements carefully.

reviews.title: Another one of those subscription apps
reviews.text: Waste of time and money. Firstly it requires that you sign in with something that’s already associated with your information, and not a basic account system with usernames. Secondly it makes you think it’s free, but it’s another one of those subscriptions apps that you’ll pay for just to use a handful of times. Thirdly, apps like these make it impossible to cancel the subscription. I saw this from an ad on instagram, saying it was “free”. Don’t do this in your promotional material. It’s misleading.
